name: 22shot
description: 22Shot — Firefox screenshot capture, editing, documents, and PDF export (100% local)

scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --target firefox-desktop
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/live-firefox-test.mjs
